title: Investigation and Search
description: Conducting an investigation after preliminary inquiry under section 19

steps.step: Enter at any reasonable time into any premises
Search for any document, record, article or evidence
Seize such document, record, article or evidence
Make a note or an inventory of such record or article
Require any person to produce any record, register or other document or article

content.authority: Director-General or any other authorised officer or District Collector

user_queries: What is document or record or article or evidence?
How does document or record or article or evidence work?
Can you explain document or record or article or evidence?
